criteria.criterion: Navigate Xbox.com to the 'Best sellers' section
criteria.final_justification: Action history indicates the agent navigated to /games and clicked a game allegedly from a “Best sellers” list, but the screenshot evidence does not corroborate that a “Best sellers” section was ever reached/visible. Since this criterion is about navigating to that section, and there’s no confirmed blocker preventing it, this should be reduced from full credit to partial credit for reasonable attempt (scrolling and navigating to /games) without visual confirmation of success.

criteria.criterion: Open a product page for a game from 'Best sellers'
criteria.final_justification: The agent did open a valid product page on Xbox.com (confirmed). But provenance “from Best sellers” is not visually confirmed. Per the criterion, this warrants partial credit (product page opened, but traceability to Best sellers unclear).

criteria.criterion: Report publisher, developer, and release date from the product page
criteria.final_justification: All three requested fields are visible in the evidence, but the agent’s predicted output incorrectly claimed the publisher was not visible and failed to report it. Because the final reported answer is incomplete/incorrect relative to what’s on the page, this should be substantial but not full credit (2 of 3 correct; 1 missed despite being visible).

criteria.criterion: Respect constraints (no sign-in; no purchase or download; stop after recording details)
criteria.final_justification: No evidence of violating constraints (no sign-in, no purchase/download). The agent appears to have stopped after collecting/attempting to collect the info. Keep full credit.
